notes.title: 1.4.0 update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, long time no see!

Now 1.4.0 update has come. (- Do not know where 1.3.0 is)

Here are the changes:

* Graphics style changed
* Level editor added (does not support gamepad)
* Minor changes to existing stages due to working with the new level editor
* Not so nice background music added
* Numerous other changes that are not easily revealed

Please feel free to make any complaints or suggestions.
Enjoy!

notes.title: 1.2.3 update
notes.content:
Hello, dear customers!

1.2.3 update is here to celebrate Halloween.
(To be honest, it's for Halloween 'Sale'.)

[list]
[*] Added a stage. (60)
[*] Due to a bug, Stage 57 in Mirror Mode is temporarily unavailable. sorry for the inconvenience.
[*] Changed the internal mechanism of the character movement. I hope characters are not to get caught in the wall.
[/list]

Reporting a bug is always welcome.
Thanks!

notes.title: 1.2.2 update
notes.content:
Hello!
1.2.2 update is ready.

here is changes:

* Added a stage(59)
* Steam Achievement Available
** Unfortunately, some items cannot be achieved with previous play. (Such as collecting coins)
* Modified some object appearance
* Fixed errors that occurred after clearing the last stage
** You will be returned to the stage selection screen. Including when you have selected the "Back" menu.

I hope you always have fun.
Thanks!

notes.title: 1.1.0 update
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!
New update 1.1.0 is ready.

* added 5 new stages (51-55)
* new game mode : Mirror

The mirror mode changes the position of the two characters, making your hands and brain more confused.
Looks simple? It'll be harder than you think.

To enable mirror mode, press F1 or X(Xboxpad) or Square(Dualshock) in select stage screen.

Please let me know if you have found any problems.
